messages:
olivia: Draft ready for final pass — product launch blog + webinar hook. Dropping latest draft and slide deck in Drive. Need: hero copy, benchmark phrasing, and confirmation on HubSpot leadflow. Pinged legal for claim language. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-draft

jeff: skimmed — nice direction. Suggest tightening hero to one strong sentence. Current: 'Predictable LLM inference at scale' -> try 'Predictable inference for production LLMs.' Shorter, clearer. :eyes:

marie: benchmarks look reasonable but we need a short method note next to the callout. Something like '(internal eval on a 1B-token test set; 95th-percentile latency reported)'. Also can we surface 'cost per 1k tokens' as the headline metric? Legal will want the measurement context.

devon: for webinar/signup funnel — recommend two CTAs: hero CTA = 'Register for the launch webinar' (immediate capture), inline CTA = 'View benchmarks & get the deck' (nurture). Need the final CTA text + HubSpot form id to wire.

dana: I can wire the HubSpot flow once I get CTA copy and hidden fields (utm_campaign, campaign_id). Also recommend adding a 'Contact sales' secondary button for enterprise leads.

legal-bot: Quick legal flag: avoid 'industry-leading' unless you have a public head-to-head. Recommend 'production-grade' or include a clear citation. Also ask to add measurement conditions for the benchmark. I'll review the citation once you drop the eval link. :scales:

olivia: Updated draft uploaded (same Drive link). Changed hero per Jeff, added method note for benchmarks, and swapped 'industry-leading' -> 'production-grade'. Also added a one-line webinar blurb for the hero CTA.

jeff: small nit — trim the second paragraph to one sentence to keep momentum above the fold. Otherwise looks good to me. +1

marie: approved on the benchmark wording pending the citation link. Can we footnote to the eval repo or an appendix in the deck? That should satisfy legal.

devon: HubSpot details below — use form id FH-12345 and include hidden fields: {"utm_source":"blog","utm_medium":"organic","utm_campaign":"redwood_launch"}. UTM example for hero link: ```?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=redwood_launch&utm_content=hero_cta``` We'll auto-tag and route enterprise leads to the sales queue.

olivia: Final checklist I'm holding us to before publish:
```
- hero copy approved
- benchmark phrasing + citation linked
- legal wording tweak applied
- HubSpot form FH-12345 wired
- webinar registration page live
- internal sales share scheduled
```
Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if good? Hoping to publish Tues EOD.

dana: I will wire the form and hidden fields today and confirm once live.

legal-bot: Legal signoff tentatively scheduled EOD pending the citation link (please paste the eval URL in this thread).

jeff: :thumbsup:

marie: :thumbsup: (will add citation link to the deck footer after QA)

olivia: thanks all — will drop the citation and push final edits by noon.
